rationale: Public action carrying an explicit HttpGet route; proven entry capability by an externally reachable declaration plus a route attribute (GCPC-020, GCPC-022).
Public conventional action with no route attribute; still published as EntryPoint with its missing-route diagnostic, preserving the legitimate EBC-08 case (GCPC-022).

Private static helper declared on a ControllerBase descendant; syntactically resembles an action but carries no ExternallyReachable evidence, so it must never be published as an EntryPoint (GCPC-020, GCPC-021). This is the audit's CatalogController.ChangeUriPlaceholder false-positive regression.
Plain class method with no ControllerBase ancestor, no route and no framework entry evidence of any kind; an unambiguous non-entry-point with nothing to confuse the classifier.
